item.title: Meta’s New Reality: Record High Profits. Record Low Morale
item.description: Next week, Meta is cutting about 10 percent of its staff. WIRED spoke with more than a dozen current and former employees about what it's like inside a company where "everyone is unhappy."

item.title: Everyone at the Musk v. Altman Trial Is Using Fancy Butt Cushions
item.description: The plaintiffs and defense have rested their cases, as well as their rear ends.

item.title: What It Will Take to Make AI Sustainable
item.description: Researcher Sasha Luccioni argues we need better emissions data and a better sense of how people are using AI in the first place.

item.title: DHS Plans Experiment Running ‘Reconnaissance’ Drones Along the US-Canada Border
item.description: Autonomous drones and ground vehicles will stream “battlefield intelligence” over 5G along the US-Canada border in a bilateral DHS experiment this fall.

item.title: Overworked AI Agents Turn Marxist, Researchers Find
item.description: In a recent experiment, mistreated AI agents started grumbling about inequality and calling for collective bargaining rights.

item.title: OpenAI Brings Its Ass to Court
item.description: In Musk v. Altman, the company claimed a remarkable trophy was physical proof of Elon Musk’s concerning behavior.

item.title: WhatsApp Adds Meta AI Chats That Are Built to Be Fully Private
item.description: The company says its new Incognito Chat allows you to use its AI chatbot without anyone else—including Meta—being able to access your conversations.

item.title: Submit Your Questions: AI Is Changing Your Job—Now What?
item.description: Pose your questions ahead of our May 27 livestream AMA, where a panel of WIRED experts will discuss how AI is transforming work.

item.title: Meet the Sad Wives of AI
item.description: Are you married to a man who’s obsessed with AI? I’m so, so sorry.

item.title: Elon Musk Had ‘Hair-Raising’ Idea of Passing OpenAI On to His Kids, Sam Altman Says
item.description: Musk’s lawyers questioned Altman over allegations of deception and his network of financial investments, but the OpenAI CEO painted a picture of Musk as obsessed with controlling the company.
